name: browser-use
headline: AI agents for Clash Royale playing on Claude
short_description: AI agents using Claude Code and multi-agent architecture to autonomously play Clash Royale. Achieved 1000+ trophies live on Twitch. Benefits game developers and AI researchers by demonstrating autonomous gameplay and multi-agent coordination.
author: houseworthe

sections.overview:
Claude Royale is an open framework that lets AI agents play Clash Royale through screen capture and input automation. It uses a multi-agent architecture where a Commander agent manages menus and game flow while spawning three parallel Player agents that coordinate to play matches together. The system has achieved 1000+ trophies in live Twitch streams with 12+ hours of autonomous gameplay. Game developers and AI researchers can use this project to study autonomous gameplay mechanics, multi-agent coordination, and vision-based decision making in real-time strategy games. The framework demonstrates how parallel inference can overcome latency constraints by naturally staggering card plays to maintain constant board pressure.
Game AI research and autonomous gameplay studies
Multi-agent coordination and parallel inference testing
Vision-based decision making in real-time strategy games
Live streaming demonstrations of AI gameplay capability

sections.usage:
```
Create a Claude Code script for a Clash Royale AI agent that specializes in [SPECIFIC STRATEGY] gameplay. The agent should be designed to play in [ARENA LEVEL] arenas and focus on [PRIMARY TARGET] units. Include multi-agent coordination features that allow this agent to communicate and strategize with up to [NUMBER] other AI agents.
```
